1.4.7
Stability of Analytical Solutions
The stability was evaluated for the Standard and Sample solutions. The standard solution and the
sample solution spiked with the impurities at the specification level were prepared and analyzed as
per the analytical procedure over a period of time using freshly prepared standard solution.
To determine stability of the Standard and Sample solution, the Standard solution were prepared and
analyzed as per the analytical procedure up to 72 hours and the sample solution were prepared and
analyzed up to 72 hours against the freshly prepared standard solutions. The results are summarized
in Table 16 and Table 17.
